_comment: Phase 211.3 — WORKSPACE-SCOPED MCP CONFIG. Watchdog §13 stamps this to every fleet workspace. _note fields may reference deprecated proxy names as documentation — do NOT grep-scan notes for dead proxies; use JSON parser on mcpServers keys only.
_comment2: Servers here: gcloud + chrome-devtools ONLY. The 3 global servers (firebase, knowledge-graph, brave-search) are registered in ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json and do NOT need to be repeated here.
_comment3: This prevents the N-tab process multiplication: each workspace window adds only gcloud + chrome (2 processes), not 5.
_hang_note: CI=true on gcloud prevents interactive gcloud auth prompts that block stdio in non-TTY MCP processes.
